# sudokUI technique attribution

The Full House, Naked Single, and Hidden Single finders in `src/techniques.ts`
are adapted from `src/engine/techniques/singles.ts` in
[AImenes/sudokUI](https://github.com/AImenes/sudokUI), commit
`6ced3d8f289c9518dad9d3677c69a4c108ab8d47`. The upstream project is
licensed under GNU GPL version 3; its license text is included alongside this
notice. The adaptations support this project's grid sizes and deficit/surplus
rules, and do not contain the upstream application's complete technique library.
